notablePrerequisites:
You control at least seven Treasures.
Raphael is indestructible.
An opponent cannot block and kill Smaug or Hellkite Charger.
description:
Declare Smaug and Hellkite Charger as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Smaug trigger, dealing at least 7 damage to Raphael.
Raphael triggers, adding at least seven {R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures you control and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
